applies_why: The judge text addresses whether Luke 2:48-49 counts as an unanswered witness and marks it answered, so it is deciding counting under K-G4.
rule_words: If the judge says a verse was answered, the judge must not count it. Not counting it obeys this rule.
why: The text says the verse was answered and therefore does not count it as an unanswered witness, which K-G4 permits.
